Dec 2025 • Family

Average
Jun 2022 • Solo
Had a late lunch here. Ordered salmon sashimi, California roll and ebi tempura. The sashimi was good but the maki had far too much roe which caused it to be too salty. The tempura on the other hand were mainly shrimp rather than prawns, which possibly explains the cheap price. Possibly better options elsewhere for Japanese food in Hanoi.

Food is decent, but service absolutely terrible!
Feb 2020 • Friends
We came as a group of three friends. Had Edamame and two small plates of Salmon Maki as a starter. There was no wasabi served with the sushi, and we had to ask 3 staff members until we finally received the wasabi we ordered. Edamame were delicious! As main we chose HotPot which we had to ask for to be served because we had to wait for faaar too long! The HotPot was okay (nothing special). To order a waterbottle: I ordered twice and then had to get up myself afterwards to walk to the counter and order it. For the bill we had to ask three times. Before leaving the restaurants I did inform the shift-manager that the service-members needs to step up the game and she seemed to be grateful for the feedback. I hope they will change something for the future clients :-)

Ambience at a great price. Our favourite restaurant in Hanoi
Sep 2019 • Couples
We came here last week and couldn't wait to come back. Japanese food cooked to perfection. Last week we tried a hotpot and salmon sushi. The staff showed us how to cook the hotpot and the order of cooking the food and cooking times. Today salmon sushi, prawn, mushroom and vegetable tempura and fried chicken. We loved all of it. We have been to Japan and this restaurant is right up there. Mugs of Sapporo beer 35,000 VND or less than $AUD 2.50. Spicy mango mocktail is divine. Can't rave about this place enough.
